subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: Should this exact head be accepted with both the Matrix dependency ownership move and the new production Gateway admission escape, or should the lifecycle seam be split for separate review?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and proven, but automation cannot authorize a dependency graph or decide whether a production channel-lifecycle seam belongs inside this large QA migration.

options.title: Approve the integrated change
options.body: Resolve conflicts, have admin or secops authorize the exact dependency graph and a Gateway lifecycle owner approve the admission escape, then rerun exact-head proof.

options.title: Split the lifecycle seam
options.body: Move the Gateway admission helper and restart call-site changes into a focused prerequisite PR, then rebase this migration onto that reviewed change.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Keep this PR and its dependent workflow PR open until ownership or merge-conflict concerns make the intended landing order clear.

recommendation.title: Approve the integrated change
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts, have admin or secops authorize the exact dependency graph and a Gateway lifecycle owner approve the admission escape, then rerun exact-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are historically connected to both the original Matrix QA implementation and Gateway lifecycle refactoring, making them the best available owner for this cross-surface choice.
